why: The wiki page display name (basename, with a trailing all-digit run collapsed into it) plus its parent directory is rendered by BOTH the web page list and the iOS flat lists, from two independent implementations (Swift cannot call the TypeScript util, and the server deliberately does not derive the name — `path` is all a client needs). This table is the single expectation set both test suites read, so changing the rule on one side without the other fails loudly.
roundTripRule: displayParent + displayName === path with trailing slashes stripped, for every case whose displayName is non-empty and whose path holds no empty segment ('//'). Both suites derive those two skips from the data instead of flagging cases.
